The '''''Bright Blast''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]]. It was later captured by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and renamed '''''Blockade Bandit'''''. The ship was eventually shot down above [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] by [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|Republic cruisers]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Its wreck was abandoned in [[Scrapheap Point]], a ship junkyard located on Raxus Prime.<ref name="BtR">''[[Beyond the Rim]]''</ref>
